notes: Seshat's military use of copper. Present means the polity had copper metal. Absent means only that it isn't recorded in military use, not that the polity had no copper.
Seshat's military use of bronze. Seshat doesn't say which bronze: arsenical bronze, which the graph doesn't model, counts too, so a polity with only arsenical bronze can show as a disagreement.
Seshat's military use of iron. Bloom (wrought) iron is the graph's only iron metal; cast iron isn't modelled.
Seshat's military use of steel. The graph's unhardened steel, which hardened steel is made from.
Seshat's social complexity variable: mines or quarries. Compared with whether the polity's area has a mapped place of any source worked by its last year (ADR 0052).
